No. 2076/14– TUESDAY, JUNE, 19, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE SERVICE MINUTE OF THE SRI LANKA PRINCIPALS' SERVICE 2ND AMENDMENT
THE Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals' Service Published in the Gazette Extraordinary of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka number 1885/31 and dated 22/10/2014 will be hereby amended
By order of the Public Service Commission.
M.A.B.DAYA SENARATH, Secretary, Public Service Commission, 13th of June, 2018.

Serial No. Paragraph No. Proposed revision 01 18. 18. Interim provisions Interim provisions are effective until 22.10.2020. 18.1 Promotion within the interim period 18.1.1. Promotion to Grade II Promotion will be given to the officers passed the efficiency bar examination mentioned in Sri Lanka Principals’ Service Minute no. 1086/26 dated 02.07.1999 to grade II at the date of completing other qualifications apart from (vii) of 10.1.1, releasing from the requirement of passing the efficiency bar examination 1 as well as capacity development training course 1 mentioned in this statute / minute when promoting officers in Class 3 to grade II during the interim period.
(Published by Authority)
PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications

Serial No. Paragraph No. Proposed revision Note: Provisions under 18.1.1 will not be applicable to the officers recruited to grade III during the interim period whereas they are to accomplish all qualifications mentioned in 10.1.1 including the efficiency bar examination 1 stated in this service minute in order to be promoted to Grade II. 18.1.2. Promotion to Grade I Officers who have passed the efficiency bar examination and who meet with other qualifications necessary for promotion to Class I under the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals’ Service No. 1086/26 dated 02.07.1999 will be released from the requirement of passing over the efficiency bar examination 1 and 2 and promoted to Grade I as at the date on which they complete other qualifications except for (v), (vi) and (vii) of section 10.2.1. Competency in the national Language should be obtained as per 9.1 of this Service Minute in order to be promoted to Grade I. Note: i. Provisions stated under 18.1.2 are not applicable for officers promoted to Grade II during the interim period and such officers should complete all qualifications stated in 10.2.1 including the second efficiency bar examination referred to in this Service Minute in order to be promoted to Grade I. ii. When grade to grade promotions of all officers recruited to the post of principal after 01.07.2007 are made they should complete the requirement of the national language stipulated by the Public Administration Circular No. 01/2014 and the Circulars incidental thereto The officers absorbed into this Service Minute will be released from the requirement of fulfilling the link language requirement referred to under 9.1 of the new Service Minute.
